title: Engineer - Roads
jobDescription: We work with public/private sector land promoters and house builders, developers, signature architects, Government, and local authorities. Some of the multi-disciplinary services we provide that you will help deliver include: Civil engineering, highways design and earthworks strategies Utilities, energy planning and coordination Drainage, flood risk and Su DS Site appraisal, due diligence, and strategic planning advice. An appreciation of hydraulics, hydrology, geotechnics and building structures is desirable as well as an understanding of construction design stages and procedures. title: Engineer - Lighting Control
jobDescription: Lead or support the design of lighting control systems across various sectors including hospitality, residential, entertainment, offices, cultural and mixed-use projects. Develop lighting control strategies, system architecture diagrams, control schematics, equipment schedules and technical specifications. Coordinate lighting control requirements with architectural lighting design, electrical systems, AV, BMS, ICT, façade, landscape and specialist systems. Define control zones, dimming groups, scene-setting requirements, user interfaces, sensors, gateways and integration points. Support the selection and technical review of lighting control equipment, panels, modules, gateways, keypads and control interfaces. Coordinate control intent with dimming protocols such as DALI, DALI-2, DALI-8, phase dimming, 0-10V, DMX, RGB/RGBW control and video/media control interfaces. Review supplier proposals, technical submittals, control narratives, shop drawings and commissioning documentation. Support project teams during tender, construction, commissioning and handover stages. Provide technical input to bids, proposals and early-stage client discussions where required. Guide junior team members and support knowledge sharing within the lighting design team. Experience in interfacing and integrating lighting control systems with theatre consultants, show control systems, AV teams and specialist entertainment systems for event-driven, performance and immersive entertainment projects would be a strong advantage. Key Competencies / Skills Mandatory Skills Ability to work independently technical understanding of lighting and related disciplines Accurate production and attention to details Able to visually communicate lighting principles Day-to-day operation of the project tasks Project issues are discussed with colleagues or team leaders. Proven track record in designing and delivering lighting control systems within the built environment. Strong understanding of lighting control protocols including DALI, DALI-2, phase dimming, DMX, 0-10V and related integration methods. Experience with scene-setting strategies, dimming curves, control zoning, emergency override, astronomical/timeclock control, sensors and user interfaces. Familiarity with reputable lighting control brands and platforms, including their architecture, configuration principles and typical project applications. Ability to produce and review control schematics, system architecture diagrams, schedules, specifications and integration requirements. Practical understanding of how lighting control systems are engineered, installed, programmed, commissioned and handed over on site. Experience coordinating with MEP, AV, BMS, ICT, architectural and interior design teams. Strong communication skills with the ability to explain technical control requirements clearly to clients, consultants, contractors and suppliers. Comfortable working across multiple project sectors and adapting control solutions to different operational needs. Knowledge of current and emerging trends in lighting controls, smart buildings, entertainment integration and user experience would be an advantage. BGV: Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India. Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Pipeline and Stress Engineer
jobDescription: We are seeking an experienced Mechanical Engineer with strong competence in gas pipeline engineering and piping stress analysis for power, energy transition, industrial gas and infrastructure projects. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in pipeline route development, pipeline mechanical design, piping material specification, wall thickness calculations, design basis preparation, stress analysis, flexibility assessment and support engineering using CAESAR II. The candidate should be capable of working across concept, FEED, detailed engineering and construction support stages, with sound knowledge of relevant pipeline, piping and pressure system codes. The role requires effective coordination with process, civil, structural, instrumentation, electrical, HSE, geotechnical, construction and project engineering teams, while ensuring safe, compliant, practical and cost-effective engineering deliverables. Prepare and review gas pipeline design basis, line lists, design criteria, material specifications, valve specifications, construction specifications and technical data sheets. Perform pipeline mechanical design checks including design pressure and temperature basis, wall thickness calculation, corrosion allowance, material selection, class location considerations and code compliance checks. Carry out piping and pipeline stress analysis using CAESAR II for above-ground piping, buried piping, compressor station piping, metering station piping, tie-ins, crossings and critical gas pipeline interfaces. Evaluate sustained, expansion, occasional and operating load cases including thermal expansion, pressure, weight, wind, seismic, settlement, slug, PSV reaction, equipment nozzle loads and anchor/support reactions. Develop and review pipe support philosophy, special support sketches, spring support requirements, anchor locations, guide/line stop arrangements and flexibility solutions. Assess interface loads on compressors, turbines, filters, separators, metering skids, pressure reduction stations, valves, vessels, flanges and equipment nozzles. Prepare and review stress analysis reports, stress isometrics, support mark-ups, load summaries, nozzle load summaries and recommendations for layout improvement. Review pipeline route drawings, alignment sheets, crossing drawings, typical installation details, plot plans, equipment layouts, piping GAs, isometrics and 3D model outputs from a mechanical and stress perspective. Support engineering for AGIs, compressor stations, pig launcher/receiver stations, metering and regulating stations, above-ground piping networks and buried pipeline systems. Coordinate with civil/structural teams for pipe rack loads, support steelwork, foundations, anchor blocks, thrust restraints, buried pipe restraints and settlement considerations. Coordinate with process and safety teams for design cases, operating envelope, pressure protection philosophy, venting, blowdown, isolation, hazardous area requirements and HAZOP/HAZID actions. Participate in technical bid evaluations, vendor document reviews, design reviews, model reviews, constructability reviews and interdisciplinary checks. Ensure engineering deliverables comply with project specifications, client requirements, applicable codes, safety standards, quality requirements and agreed schedules. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Pipeline Engineering, Piping Engineering, Energy Engineering or equivalent. Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in gas pipeline engineering, piping engineering, piping stress analysis or mechanical design for EPC, consultancy, owner’s engineer or operating company environments. Advanced hands-on experience with CAESAR II for piping stress analysis, including model development, load case preparation, code stress checking, buried pipe modelling, support optimisation and report preparation. Strong working knowledge of gas pipeline and piping codes such as ASME B31.8, ASME B31.3, ASME B31.4, ASME B31.1, EN 1594, IGEM/TD/1, API, ISO and other relevant project-specific standards. Good understanding of gas pipeline systems including transmission pipelines, high-pressure gas distribution, AGIs, compressor stations, pressure reduction stations, metering stations, pigging facilities and tie-ins. Experience in pipeline mechanical calculations such as wall thickness, pressure design, flexibility, expansion, thrust/anchor force, support loads, allowable stress checks and equipment interface loads. Ability to review and challenge pipeline routing, piping layouts, isometrics, support arrangements, constructability, maintainability and operability from a mechanical engineering perspective. Knowledge of materials, valves, fittings, flanges, gaskets, insulation, corrosion protection, coating, cathodic protection interfaces, hydrotest requirements and commissioning support activities. Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and communicate technical decisions clearly through calculations, reports, mark-ups, review comments and presentations. Preferred Experience Experience in UK, Europe, Middle East or international gas pipeline projects, including compliance with client, statutory and regulatory requirements. Experience in hydrogen-ready pipelines, natural gas transmission, fuel gas systems, power plant gas supply systems, CCUS/low carbon projects, biomethane or industrial gas infrastructure projects. Exposure to compressor station piping, high-pressure gas let-down systems, metering skids, pig launcher/receiver systems, underground and above-ground tie-ins, hot tapping and brownfield modification works. Familiarity with 3D model review tools such as Navisworks, Smart 3D, E3D/PDMS or equivalent, and ability to provide actionable comments to piping designers and CAD teams. Understanding of pipeline construction, welding, NDT, pressure testing, pre-commissioning, commissioning, as-built documentation and site technical query resolution. Knowledge of dynamic analysis, vibration screening, acoustic induced vibration, flow induced vibration, fatigue assessment and specialist stress analysis methods will be an advantage. Chartered Engineer status or working towards professional registration with IMech E, ICE, IGEM or equivalent professional body will be an advantage. Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Principal Engineer -Substation
jobDescription: WSP ME team has ambitions to significantly expand our energy team. We have a range of roles available to suit people at all points of their career and development. We are seeking a Technical Expert with core expertise in Electrical domain with proven experience on power generation, Wind and Solar Power Plants. The incumbent would be a professional with strong technical expertise who will be managing overall electrical team, enable timely and quality delivery of projects. Role relating to Principal Engineer– Electrical for Power, Water & Renewables projects. This includes (but not limited to): The candidate should have strong technical knowledge in both primary & secondary detailed engineering of power plant electrical design, interfaces and subject matter expert at least one of them. Perform design review for electrical deliverables related to power, water and renewables projects while acting as a lead and directly interfacing with clients. Candidate shall have expertise in basic design/review of electrical substation facilities including Single Line Diagram, Protection Single Line diagram, General Arrangement layout, Transformer Sizing, Earthing and Lightening Protection, Sectional Layout, Lightning protection, LT AC/DC diagrams, Lighting, ground mat design, Power One Line diagram, schematic diagrams, wiring diagrams, Panel GA drawing, BOM of P&C Panel, LT AC/DC diagrams. Preparation of project specifications for material and equipment purchase and installation. Experience in basic/detail engineering for power generation projects preferably with CCGT plants. Delivery of accurate and thorough designs that will meet industry standards and specifications, and meet good engineering practice with excellent constructability. Review of internal and external designs for code compliance, good design practice and constructability. Resolving site queries during the construction phase of projects. Maintaining complete project documentation with respect to substation design and construction, including all completion packages, as-built requirements and return data information. Assist in the preparation of technical inquiry requests (Inquiry Requisitions) to vendors, participate in the technical evaluation of vendor bid offers. Partake in Technical Bid Evaluations (TBE), review vendor drawings and documents. Review design calculations, ensure vendor equipment specifications meet with client equipment specifications and are within budgeted costs. Ability to lead the projects and deal the client with hands on experience in project management processes/activities. Good understanding of PPP projects structure, stakeholders, PPAs, ECAs and related contractual documents. Willingness to visit client offices/project sites in ME as and when required. Possess a Graduate or Post Graduate Degree in Electrical engineering from an accredited institution. Preferably familiar with ME projects. Experience in Power, Water and Renewable e.g. solar, wind and BESS projects is preferred. Experience of working on projects with Middle East clients will be strong differentiator. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Demonstrated leadership skills, Strong problem solving and analytical skills. Self-motivated and eager learner, aptitude to grow and develop within the field. title: Engineer Water & Wastewater_C3D
jobDescription: The suitable candidate for this role is an engineer specializing in Water and Wastewater Design & Digital Delivery. The Engineer – Water and Wastewater Design role involves close coordination with design engineers and peer groups across India and New Zealand, taking ownership of hydraulic design, 3D modelling, drafting, and preparation of design documentation for water supply and wastewater (sewerage and drainage) utility networks. The role covers end-to-end engineering deliverables, from concept-stage hydraulic calculations through to detailed Civil 3D modelling, layout and long-section drawings, and comprehensive design reports. The focus is on delivering high-quality, construction-ready engineering outputs that meet project and client requirements. Water & Wastewater Engineering & Hydraulic Design Perform hydraulic design of water supply distribution systems, including pipe sizing, pressure analysis, network balancing, and reservoir/storage capacity calculations. Design wastewater collection systems, including gravity sewers, slope/gradient determination, invert level calculations, and manhole/chamber layouts. Carry out engineering calculations using established hydraulic principles and verify outputs against project requirements and standards. Develop and document design basis, assumptions, and calculation methodologies for each project stage. Ensure all design outputs meet applicable codes, client specifications, and industry best practices. Civil 3D Modelling & Drafting Create and manage terrain surfaces using survey, GIS, and other spatial data inputs. Develop pipe network models for both pressurised water systems and gravity sewer systems using Civil 3D. Perform alignment design, corridor modelling, and generate profiles and cross-sections. Apply and maintain drawing styles, annotations, and labelling standards in accordance with project requirements. Work efficiently within Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC) for document control, coordination, and multidisciplinary collaboration. Support digital engineering workflows and contribute to improving modelling efficiency and standardisation. Prepare high-quality general arrangement drawings, key plans, and utility layout drawings for water and wastewater networks. Produce longitudinal sections (long sections) showing ground levels, invert levels, gradients, crossings, and utility interfaces. Develop cross-sections, standard details, and manhole/chamber drawings to construction-ready standards. Ensure all drawings comply with project drafting standards, quality requirements, and revision control procedures. Maintain consistency, clarity, and accuracy across all drawing deliverables. Design Reports & Documentation Prepare comprehensive design reports detailing design basis, methodology, assumptions, calculations, results, and conclusions. Develop calculation sheets, technical specifications, and Schedule of Quantities (SOQ) for tender and construction purposes. Maintain and manage drawing registers, calculation logs, and document control systems throughout project lifecycle. Support internal QA/QC processes and incorporate review comments to ensure high-quality deliverables. Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to ensure completeness and alignment of documentation. Required Technical and Soft Skills Strong grounding in water supply and wastewater system design principles: hydraulics, pipe network analysis, and basic treatment process awareness. Working knowledge of pipe materials (DI, MS, HDPE, RCC, GRP, etc.), valves, fittings, and appurtenances commonly used in utility projects. Familiarity with construction methodologies for buried water and wastewater utilities Demonstrated ability to independently produce: Network layouts and general arrangement drawings Longitudinal sections and cross sections Detail drawings (manholes, chambers, valve pits, thrust blocks) Design calculation sheets and complete design reports Strong proficiency in spoken and written English, with the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly, concisely, and effectively. Good interpersonal skills and ability to collaborate with multidisciplinary and cross-regional teams. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining high-quality deliverables. Demonstrates resilience and adaptability, with the ability to navigate change, ambiguity, and evolving project requirements. Software Proficiencies Must Have Auto CAD Civil 3D (Essential): Advanced proficiency in modelling, drafting, pipe network design (pressure and gravity), surface creation, alignment and profile generation, and integration with BIM workflows. GIS Platforms: Proficient in Arc GIS and QGIS for spatial data analysis, utility mapping, and integration of survey/GIS datasets, including familiarity with New Zealand GIS data sources and council databases. Microsoft Office Suite: Word: Preparation of technical reports and design documentation Excel: Development of calculation sheets, data analysis, and design validation Good to Have / Additional Tools Hydraulic Modelling Software (Desirable): Experience with Bentley Sewer GEMS / Water GEMS or similar tools for hydraulic modelling and network analysis. Auto CAD Plant 3D / Revit: For BIM coordination and multidisciplinary design environments Navisworks: For model review, clash detection, and coordination Autodesk Construction Cloud (ACC): For document control and collaborative project delivery Master's in Water Resource or Environmental Engineering (or related field) Experience 4 to 8 years of relevant experience in the design and delivery of water supply and wastewater utility infrastructure projects. Demonstrated experience in the planning, hydraulic design, and detailed delivery of water distribution networks (including transmission mains) and wastewater collection systems (gravity and pressurised), along with associated infrastructure such as pumping stations, reservoirs, and manholes, including preparation of engineering deliverables such as design calculations, Civil 3D models, general arrangement drawings, longitudinal sections, and technical reports, while working on multidisciplinary infrastructure projects with effective coordination across civil, mechanical, and digital delivery teams. Experience with other international projects (UK, US, Middle East, etc.) will be considered advantageous. title: Principal Engineer - Geochemist/Water Quality Modeller
jobDescription: WSP India is seeking a highly experienced for a Principal Geochemist / Mine Water Quality Modeller to join our GCC team supporting the Australia Mining & Metals business. In this role, you will support Australian mining projects through geochemical assessment, mine water quality prediction, hydrogeochemical interpretation, water quality modelling and environmental approvals support. You will work closely with Australian technical leaders and multidisciplinary project teams to support studies across the mining project lifecycle, including baseline assessment, operations, environmental approvals, mine closure and post-closure water quality prediction. The role will involve developing and reviewing technical approaches, models, reports, regulatory submissions and other project deliverables. You will also help coordinate work with other disciplines, mentor junior team members and contribute to practical, high-quality outcomes for mining clients. The position will be for Mumbai/ Bangalore location. The Principal Geochemist / Mine Water Quality Modeller Engineer shall have experience mainly in following • Develop and review scopes of work, schedules and budgets for geochemistry, mine water quality and environmental assessment tasks. • Support mine water quality prediction studies, including geochemical interpretation, hydrogeochemical assessment and water quality modelling. • Develop, direct and review assessment approaches for mining projects, including model development, calibration, validation and sensitivity assessment. • Prepare and review technical reports, memoranda, presentations, regulatory submissions and other project deliverables. • Manage, analyze and interpret measured and modelled water quality, geochemical and environmental monitoring data. • Provide quality control and technical review for data collection, data management, modelling assumptions and reporting outputs. • Support geochemical assessment of mine materials, including waste rock, tailings, pit environments and other mine-related sources that may influence water quality, where relevant to project scope. • Contribute to Mine closure and post-closure studies where long-term water quality prediction, water management or geochemical risk assessment is required. • Work with multidisciplinary project teams to support environmental approvals, permits, water licenses and regulatory submissions for mining projects. • Coordinate with Australian technical leads, project managers and discipline teams to deliver work within agreed scope, budget, schedule and quality expectations. • Supervise, train and mentor junior and intermediate staff to develop technical, project delivery, consulting and decision-making capability. • Promote a strong culture of health, safety, quality and practical project delivery. • Support client relationships and business development opportunities by contributing technical input to proposals, project discussions and capability material KEY COMPETENCIES / SKILLS • Experience supporting environmental assessment, permitting, approvals or regulatory submissions for mining or industrial projects. • Demonstrated ability to manage technical tasks, coordinate inputs from others and deliver work products in a timely manner within a consulting environment. • Excellent technical writing, data interpretation and communication skills. • Demonstrated project management, technical review and quality assurance capability. • Ability to work with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams, including collaboration with Australian project teams and technical leaders. • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and maintain flexibility across multiple projects. • Experience mentoring junior or intermediate staff and supporting capability development within a technical team. DESIRABLE TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE Mining geochemistry and mine water quality • Acid rock drainage / acid and metalliferous drainage assessment. • Static and kinetic geochemical characterization. • Waste rock and tailing geochemistry. • Pit lake, seepage, groundwater or surface water quality prediction. • Mine closure water quality assessment and long-term water quality risk interpretation. • Reactive transport or hydrogeochemical modelling. Software and modelling tools • Experience with one or more relevant geochemical, water quality or hydrogeological modelling tools such as PHREEQC, Gold Sim, Geochemist’s Workbench, MIN3P, MODFLOW, FEFLOW or equivalent software. • Experience managing, checking and interpreting measured and modelled datasets, including clear documentation of assumptions, limitations and conclusions. A university bachelor’s or master’s degree in Geochemistry, Environmental Science, Environmental Engineering, Hydrogeology, Geology, Water Resources, Chemistry or a related discipline. Minimum of 13-16 years of relevant experience, ideally with mining, consulting, environmental assessment or mine water quality project experience. Proven experience in water quality modelling and interpretation, preferably in a mining, hydro geochemistry or environmental geochemistry context. Strong understanding of mine water quality prediction, geochemical assessment, hydrogeochemical processes and mining-related environmental practices. Experience with projects in Australia, New Zealand would be an advantage. Professional Membership & qualifications CENG/PENG of relevant professional bodies is desirable. Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Engineer - Airfield
jobDescription: The WSP Aviation team is seeking an experienced Airfield Civil Engineer within our Indian office. The primary function of this role will be to support the Airfield Principal Engineer, however there will be potential to become a Senior Airfield Civil Engineer as the GCC Airfield Engineering team grows and develops. The successful candidate will be among one of the first members of this team and will form a crucial role in its growth and development. The Airfield Civil Engineer will be responsible in supporting delivering airfield civil engineering design and maintenance projects through various stages of design from feasibility/ option studies to detailed design and onto construction for various clients both in the UK and overseas. The candidate will be required to: Act as a Civil Airfield Engineer for airfield civil engineering projects. Take ownership in the production of technical designs whilst giving technical leadership and mentorship to more junior engineers in the team. Undertake the preparation of technical reports, calculations, drawings and specifications related to the delivery of airfield engineering projects in both the UK and overseas. Contribute towards technical design reviews as required to meet the WSP quality management requirements. Read and accurately interpret, review, amend and reproduce engineering drawings using Auto CAD and Civil 3D software. Ability to manage drawing registers and revision control processes. Respond to client directions in a professional and customer focused manner and to develop and maintain relationships with clients, peers and others who are influential in providing future business. Actively participate in the design and take ownership in providing technical input to the design team throughout the full design process. Effectively and confidently communicate and coordinate designs with team members, industry associates and Clients as required. Identify and support in the management of design risks, issues and Request for Information (RFIs). Support the Principal Airfield Civil Engineer as directed by monitoring and contributing to the development of appropriate project controls, including change management, information management and document control. Follow the technical quality requirements, address the project brief and meet client deadlines. Champion excellent health and safety in design. The current team is diverse and well respected across the industry therefore the candidate is required to have sound technical abilities. The successful candidate will be knowledgeable and experienced in Civil Engineering projects at airports and preferably have a degree in Civil Engineering. Minimum Requirements Civil engineering experience of working on large, technically complex airport projects from the detailed design and construction support stages. Experience working within an engineering team in the delivery of technical aviation projects, sharing ideas and collaborating with colleagues and be able to demonstrate a time when you’ve managed to do this successfully to solve complex problems. Strong verbal and written communication skills when providing design information or interacting with team members, industry associates and Clients, regardless of their technical abilities. Competent self-discipline with attention to detail, multi-tasking, and prioritisation of responsibilities in a dynamic work environment to meet the needs of multiple projects and managers. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision, as well as part of a team to meet the technical and design objectives as directed by the Airfield Principal Engineer. Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with strict deadlines. Experience of international airfield design standards such as ICAO and FAA. Knowledge and experience of using Auto CAD, Civil 3D and relevant other airfield engineering design software packages such as Avi Plan, Sky Safe and FAARFIELD is preferable but not essential. Proficiency with Microsoft Office programs (Word, Excel, Outlook). Preferred Qualifications Civil Engineering Degree or equivalent relevant qualification Chartered or Incorporated Status (MICE, MCIHT or equivalent) or equivalent demonstrable experience is preferable but not essential. Knowledge and experience of using Civil 3D and relevant other airfield engineering design software packages such as Avi Plan, Sky Safe and FAARFIELD is preferable but not essential. BGV: Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India. Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Engineer - Tailings
jobDescription: WSP is seeking a Engineer-Tailings to join our large and growing technical support team in Bengaluru, supporting our global Mining business. The successful applicant will perform specialist analyses related to mining projects, specifically focusing on tailings storage facilities (TSFs), under the direction of a global team of mining, geotechnical, and tailings (mine waste) engineering professionals. The successful candidate will report to the Mining Team Leader as part of the WSP GCC-IN Mining Specialist Team, delivering the highest standards of technical work and contributing to the continued success of the mining business by supporting client-focused project delivery. The role involves close collaboration with WSP’s global mining leaders and will focus on numerical analyses and tailings management solutions. Technical duties will include conducting analyses, reviewing data, and preparing technical inputs for reports related to tailings storage facilities. As a Tailings Engineer within the Global Capability Centre India (WSP-GCC-IN), you will serve as a technical leader in the execution and delivery of mine waste engineering solutions for international mining projects. You will work as an integrated part of WSP’s global mining business, closely collaborating with lead country teams, contributing to high-quality project deliverables, mentoring technical staff, and supporting internal development initiatives. This is a delivery-focused role with no direct client interaction. Lead the technical execution and review of designs for mine waste facilities including tailings storage facilities, water storage impoundments, waste rock dumps, heap leach pads, and integrated waste facilities. Ensure all deliverables meet design expectations in line with global industry standards including GISTM, ICOLD, CDA, and country-specific guidelines, as directed by lead country teams. Provide specialized input on geotechnical and civil engineering aspects such as slope stability, seepage and deposition modelling, filter compatibility, soil mechanics, ground improvement, and geosynthetics. Prepare and review key technical documents including calculations, drawings, specifications, risk assessments, OMS manuals, and project reports. Lead the technical delivery of assigned project packages, working in close coordination with lead country Project Managers and Discipline Leads. Coordinate multi-disciplinary inputs from within the GCC team to ensure integration of design components and timely submission of deliverables. Track progress of tasks and deliverables using tools such as Jira or other project management platforms as required by the lead country teams. Ensure efficient and high-quality technical outputs that align with scope, schedule, and budget set by lead countries. Mentor junior and intermediate engineers within the GCC team, providing technical guidance, reviewing outputs, and fostering a learning culture. Identify technical development needs and support upskilling of team members through handson training and knowledge sharing. Provide QA/QC oversight on deliverables prepared by the GCC team. Actively participate in global mining technical networks and internal practice area groups to align with WSP’s global delivery standards. Collaborate with engineering specialists and design teams from other WSP offices to support multi-office delivery of projects. Contribute to the development and delivery of internal training modules, technical workshops, and knowledge-sharing sessions. Maintain and enhance contributions to internal experience databases and knowledge management systems. Provide technical input and support for internal strategy development and resource planning to enhance team capability and delivery efficiency. Assist lead countries in the preparation of technical proposal inputs and resource planning during the bidding stage, as requested. Promote and uphold WSP’s health, safety, environmental, and quality standards across all project work. Ensure compliance with local and international protocols for safety, risk management, data protection, and design quality. Mandatory Skills • Excellent spoken and written English • A strong technical background in geotechnical, civil or mining engineering with proven expertise in numerical analyses • Willing to learn new software codes. Qualifications • Educated to Master’s/Phd degree level in geotechnical, civil or mining engineering • 6-10 years of experience in Tailings Management. title: Senior Model Automation Engineer
jobDescription: The Role Energy, Economy and Environment modelling as part of WSP plc develops and maintains large-scale applied mathematical models that represent the energy, environment and economy, supporting quantitative analysis and policy design. Its integrated modelling tools provide informed, transparent and robust analysis as well as recommendations for its high-profile clients which include the European Commission, national governments, energy regulators and a number of private companies in the energy and transport sectors, financial institutions and strategic consultancies. This role is about supporting the Chief Modelling Engineer to improve the design of the models operations (data collection/harmonisation, database access, HPC computing, model development principles). Suggest, design, and implement modelling automation routines to improve workflow efficiency in cooperation with the energy and economic modelling teams. Design and maintain data workflows and quality assurance processes for large modelling databases (inputs, intermediate outputs, and results). Develop and operate automated data extraction pipelines via APIs to feed models with timely and consistent datasets. Configure and use HPC/cluster computing and parallel processing solutions to run large-scale simulations and batch model runs. Develop and maintain internal tools and scripts for workflow orchestration, including scheduling, monitoring, and logging of model runs. Help develop and maintain internal tools for version control, continuous integration, unit testing, backup and documentation using Git/Git Hub and similar applications. jobDescription:
WSP is seeking an experienced GIS Consultant to join our multidisciplinary team supporting the US Earth & Environment (E&E) Business Line. The GIS consultant will provide advanced expertise in geospatial analyses, environmental data management, and cartographic support for projects related to site investigation and remediation, power generation and distribution, environmental impact assessments, environmental planning and permitting, and other similar areas. Strong understanding of geodatabase design and management, including domains, subtypes, and feature class operations. title: Project Scheduler
jobDescription: WSP India is currently seeking Project Scheduler for our UK offshore Wind Energy Projects. Ensure all project/discipline related risks are raised. Record risk items, update, and maintain risk register. Key Competencies/Skills Experience with Project scheduling & Primavera P6 a must. Mandatory Skills 8-12 years Experience with Project scheduling with Offshore Wind energy or Offshore O & G or Marine industry experience. Attention to detail is critical Familiarity with other analytics tools such as Power Point, Excel, Power BI & equivalent dashboards. Excellent verbal and written communication skills and effective interpersonal skills Work experience on cost control will be an added advantage. Must be Flexible to attend meetings outside office hours or early in the morning to align with UK time. Previous experience in an EPCM environment in the Offshore Wind energy or Offshore O & G or Marineis an asset. Must have minimum 8-12 years of experience post-graduation, preferably relating to a large-scale professional services work environment. title: Senior Engineer - Geochemist/Water Quality Modeller
jobDescription: WSP India is seeking a highly experienced for a Senior Geochemist / Mine Water Quality Modeller to join our GCC team supporting the Australia Mining & Metals business. In this role, you will support Australian mining projects through geochemical assessment, mine water quality prediction, hydrogeochemical interpretation, water quality modelling and environmental approvals support. You will work closely with Australian technical leaders and multidisciplinary project teams to support studies across the mining project lifecycle, including baseline assessment, operations, environmental approvals, mine closure and post-closure water quality prediction. The role will involve developing and reviewing technical approaches, models, reports, regulatory submissions and other project deliverables. You will also help coordinate work with other disciplines, mentor junior team members and contribute to practical, high-quality outcomes for mining clients. The position will be for Mumbai/ Bangalore location. The Senior Geochemist / Mine Water Quality Modeller Engineer shall have experience mainly in following • Develop and review scopes of work, schedules and budgets for geochemistry, mine water quality and environmental assessment tasks. • Support mine water quality prediction studies, including geochemical interpretation, hydrogeochemical assessment and water quality modelling. • Develop, direct and review assessment approaches for mining projects, including model development, calibration, validation and sensitivity assessment. • Prepare and review technical reports, memoranda, presentations, regulatory submissions and other project deliverables. • Manage, analyze and interpret measured and modelled water quality, geochemical and environmental monitoring data. • Provide quality control and technical review for data collection, data management, modelling assumptions and reporting outputs. • Support geochemical assessment of mine materials, including waste rock, tailings, pit environments and other mine-related sources that may influence water quality, where relevant to project scope. • Contribute to Mine closure and post-closure studies where long-term water quality prediction, water management or geochemical risk assessment is required. • Work with multidisciplinary project teams to support environmental approvals, permits, water licenses and regulatory submissions for mining projects. • Coordinate with Australian technical leads, project managers and discipline teams to deliver work within agreed scope, budget, schedule and quality expectations. • Supervise, train and mentor junior and intermediate staff to develop technical, project delivery, consulting and decision-making capability. • Promote a strong culture of health, safety, quality and practical project delivery. • Support client relationships and business development opportunities by contributing technical input to proposals, project discussions and capability material KEY COMPETENCIES / SKILLS • Experience supporting environmental assessment, permitting, approvals or regulatory submissions for mining or industrial projects. • Demonstrated ability to manage technical tasks, coordinate inputs from others and deliver work products in a timely manner within a consulting environment. • Excellent technical writing, data interpretation and communication skills. • Demonstrated project management, technical review and quality assurance capability. • Ability to work with multidisciplinary and geographically distributed teams, including collaboration with Australian project teams and technical leaders. • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities and maintain flexibility across multiple projects. • Experience mentoring junior or intermediate staff and supporting capability development within a technical team. DESIRABLE TECHNICAL EXPERIENCE Mining geochemistry and mine water quality • Acid rock drainage / acid and metalliferous drainage assessment. • Static and kinetic geochemical characterization. • Waste rock and tailing geochemistry. • Pit lake, seepage, groundwater or surface water quality prediction. • Mine closure water quality assessment and long-term water quality risk interpretation. • Reactive transport or hydrogeochemical modelling. Support in Application for Payments (Af Ps) and invoicing on a monthly basis.
5. ERP / Horizon Data Management Use Horizon / ERP systems to support project lifecycle management from setup through delivery and close-out. Support working capital visibility and project financial performance reporting.

Assist in capturing commercial or delivery-related impacts arising from changes. Ensure changes are reflected in reporting outputs and coordinated with relevant PMO / commercial teams.

Support compliance with PMO frameworks, templates, reporting cycles, and governance requirements. Maintain documentation and audit trails for key project controls activities. Support continuous improvement of PMO processes, trackers, and reporting approaches.
9. Planning & Scheduling Maintain a basic understanding of planning and scheduling concepts. Ability to interpret schedule inputs for reporting purposes where required. Coordinate with planning teams to obtain schedule updates and progress inputs. Knowledge of Primavera P6 / MS Project is beneficial but not mandatory. Technical Requirements Strong proficiency in: Advanced MS Excel Power Query Working knowledge of: Project controls principles Cost tracking and forecasting ERP/project lifecycle data management Reporting and governance processes Experience using or supporting ERP/project systems such as: Horizon / SAP, Ecosys or similar project / financial management systems Exposure to Power BI or similar reporting tools is desirable. Basic familiarity with Primavera P6 / Microsoft Project is desirable. Experience & Qualifications Essential Bachelor’s degree in Engineering . Master’s degree in Project Management or Construction Management . 5–8 years of experience in project controls, PMO, project support, or project reporting roles. Experience working in a professional services, engineering, infrastructure, or consultancy environment. Strong analytical, organisational, and communication skills. Good attention to detail and ability to manage structured project data. title: Senior Technician, Drafting Support
jobDescription:
To provide technical drafting support to the Middle East Power & Energy business in the field of engineering The range of activities includes:
1. Preparation and development of engineering deliverables including Single Line Diagrams (SLD), Process Flow Diagrams (PFD), P&ID, Loop Drawings, Cable Block Diagrams, Plant Layouts, Cable Routing and Switchgear Configurations using 2D and 3D design software.
2. Development of detailed engineering drawings such as Land Utilization Plans, Elevations, Above & Below Ground Conduit Layouts, Grounding Layouts, Lighting & Lightning Protection Layouts and Bill of Materials.

Preparation and development of engineering drawings and design documentation for energy and infrastructure projects.  Produce detailed layouts, schematics and construction drawings in accordance with project requirements and applicable standards.  Develop grounding, lighting, lightning protection and conduit routing layouts along with associated design details.  Prepare and maintain Bills of Materials (BOM) and other project documentation.  Coordinate design activities with Civil, Mechanical, Electrical and other engineering disciplines.  Support project teams in achieving design milestones and submission schedules.  Participate in design review meetings with clients and internal stakeholders.  Ensure compliance with company quality standards, drafting practices and client requirements.  Review and update existing engineering drawings and documentation as required.  Perform periodic quality checks on drawings prepared by engineers and designers.  Collaborate with global and regional offices on project delivery activities.  Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior designers and technicians.  Identify opportunities for improving design workflows, tools and project execution processes.  Proactively resolve design coordination issues and support multidisciplinary problem-solving.  Participate in organizational training programs and continuous improvement initiatives. Key Competencies / Skills Mandatory Skills  Experience in preparation of Engineering design and drafting deliverables.  Strong knowledge of engineering drawing standards and drafting practices.  Experience in cable routing, electrical layouts, grounding systems and switchgear configuration drawings.  Ability to coordinate with multidisciplinary engineering teams.  Knowledge of engineering design software and drafting tools.  Strong quality control and documentation management skills.  Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.  Ability to work independently and manage project deadlines.  Excellent oral and written communication skills.  Good computer skills Desired Skills  Experience working on Power, Energy or Infrastructure projects.  Knowledge of multidisciplinary engineering design processes.  Experience in implementation of design automation and process improvement initiatives.  Leadership and mentoring capabilities for developing junior team members.  Diploma in Engineering or equivalent technical discipline.  Relevant experience in engineering design and drafting projects.  Proficient in Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, Power Point and Outlook.  Strong analytical, problem-solving and organizational skills.  Self-motivated professional with willingness to learn and develop within the engineering field. title: Principal Engineer - Stormwater or River Hydraulic Modelling ICM
jobDescription: The suitable candidate for this role is an emerging technical leader in Stormwater or River Hydraulic Modelling. As a Principal Engineer, you will be be the stormwater or river hydraulic modelling technical lead or reviewer for stormwater or river hydraulic modelling projects. You will effectively lead the technical delivery, whilst delegating and upskilling junior members of the team. The role involves coordination with engineers and peergroups across India and New Zealand while reporting to the Head of Department in India. The ideal candidate would be provide coaching to junior members on projects, as well as act as a mentor to wider team members. Leads the technical delivery of a stormwater or river hydraulic modelling. Applies hydraulic principles for river and/or stormwater infrastructure planning, including stormwater networks, culverts, bridges, and open channel and 2D surface flow for clients using Innovyze ICM or Tuflow software for modelling projects and tasks, including preparation of reports, figures and other documents to a high level of grammatical and technical presentation. Uses Innovyze ICM and/or Tuflow software to build, update or test options/scenarios for river and/or stormwater systems. This includes model schematisation, assessment of model inputs and gap analysis, model build, validation and calibration, system performance assessment, and floodplain and hazard mapping. Carries out project works in accordance with our Integrated Management System (IMS). Work alongside project managers and junior team members to ensure efficient delivery. Delivers through teams, not individually. Develops hydrologic models and urban hydrology for use in hydraulic modelling. Interprets and manipulates geospatial datasets for hydraulic modelling using Arc GIS or QGIS. Interprets hydraulic models and outputs for infrastructure planning. Applies sound engineering judgement to resolve modelling anomalies to improve overall modelling confidence and communicates all risks and limitations on use of hydraulic models to the project team and the client. Works without supervision, direct others and ensures their work is verified by an appropriate professional. Successfully supports, coaches and mentors hydraulic modelling professionals to achieve a good standard of hydraulic modelling, embedding a culture of successful project delivery whilst also holding them to account, reducing re-work and supporting the continuous growth of the WSP stormwater or river hydraulic modelling capability. Ensures project related quality processes are carried out (technical reviews, verification, approval to release etc.) in a timely and cost-effectively manner. Undertakes appropriate verification of all inputs and outputs on hydraulic modelling projects. Provides regular feedback to team members in a constructive and timely manner. Completes tasks within allocated timeframes and budgeted hours. Ensures all technical risks are understood, managed, assigned to the organisation best placed to manage the risk, and these are well communicated with the project team, and/or client. Solves problems effectively by applying knowledge of hydraulics and engaging sound problem solving techniques and appropriate analysis to find value engineered/innovative solutions. Maintains knowledge of appropriate technical standards, legislation, codes of practice and New Zealand standards; Is knowledgeable on industry developments, trends, and processes. Applies sound judgement to decisions about technical issues and solves problems for clients to get the best possible outcome for a project. Undertakes appropriate verification of projects and team members’ work. Considering risks to client’s business or reputation as part of the planning and management of projects. Delivering excellent service to clients to promote repeat and uncompetitive work. Develops and maintains an extensive network of industry contacts in India and NZ (as a minimum) and is readily able to access key people. Builds and maintains strong, trusted relationships with clients. Actively seeks feedback from clients and communicate this to the team to ensure successful delivery of projects and lessons learnt. Ensure projects and variations are scoped and priced in a manner that will ensure commercial success and that respond to the specific risk profile of the project. Writes and supports bids that are commercially astute, recognises and manages commercial risks while demonstrating value to the client. Hold focused meetings that achieve appropriate outcomes at key times; Deliver engaging, informative well-organized presentations; Create opportunities to share learnings, improvements, new tools, better practices etc with the wider water team. Liaise and work closely with Sector leadership and peer groups across India and New Zealand; Act as a brand ambassador of GCC within WSP in India across geographies. Required Skills and Behaviours Fluent in spoken and written English and able to present ideas, complex technical information and advice in a way that is understandable to a wide range of audiences; Communicate difficult/sensitive information tactfully. Able to work effectively and competently with people at all levels; within and external to the organisation. Ability to work collaboratively and demonstrated capability to perform effectively as part of a team across a matrix type structure. Models WSP Guiding Principles. Strong organisational ability to optimise and prioritise conflicting demands in a busy environment, to achieve deadlines and see responsibilities through to completion; copes well under conflicting pressures. Commercial and a level of maturity needed to understand business needs and drivers. Projects a credible image and inspires confidence; Excellent interpersonal skills. Able to manage others and support them through stressful or challenging situations. Results orientated, with a reputation for, and demonstrated achievement of, key strategic priorities. Active commitment to continuous personal improvement. A team player and considers the views of others. Ensures that confidentiality is respected and maintained at all times. Consistently demonstrates trustworthiness, integrity, professionalism and honesty. Natural and confident leader displaying openness, accountability, decisiveness and engagement; Client centric and passionate about service excellence . Displays drive, energy and enthusiasm for getting things done with high levels of motivation and energy; Project credibility demonstrate professionalism and inspire confidence with high emotional intelligence and self-awareness of strengths and potential areas for development. Excellent analytical skills and strong attention to detail. Resilient, comfortable with change and ambiguity. Software Proficiencies Must be highly proficient in Innovyze ICM software for stormwater hydraulic modelling, or Tuflow software for river hydraulic modelling. Highly capable of using Arc GIS or QGIS to deliver stormwater and/or river hydraulic modelling projects. Proficient use of Windows, MS Word/Excel and other Microsoft Office applications. Bachelors Degree in Civil Engineering followed by a Masters in Water Resource Engineering or Environmental Engineering or similar Professional Registration (Chartered Engineer status or equivalent). Experience Minimum of 12 years’ experience post qualification in stormwater and/or river hydraulic modelling. Must have at least 6 years’ experience using either Innovyze ICM software for stormwater hydraulic modelling, or Tuflow software WS Pro software for river hydraulic modelling. Must have extensive use in ICM or Tuflow within the last 12 months. Demonstrable experience in using Arc GIS or QGIS to deliver stormwater and/or river hydraulic modelling projects. Automation or coding of hydraulic modelling activities is desirable. Past experience in NZ, Australian or UK projects is preferred but not essential. BGV: Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India. Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: BIM Engineer - Acoustics
jobDescription: WSP is seeking a Principal Consultant with expertise in Acoustics to join our large and growing team in India to work with our UK acoustics team. The successful applicant will operate within a team of environmental professionals in Noida or Bengaluru and will be part of the WSP UK acoustics team, delivering the highest standards of technical work and aiding the continued success of the acoustics team by being an integral part of our client focused delivery of projects. The work will initially have a noise assessment focus using UK British Standards and guidance documents, including modelling and providing input into technical reports. There will also be opportunities for the applicant to continue developing their consultancy skills, provide costings for proposals and support with the coordination and management of acoustic team members within India. With approximately 45 acousticians in the UK and three acousticians in India, covering Environmental, Building Acoustics and complex vibration assessments, we are proud of our wide-ranging knowledge and expertise. You will be joining a well-respected, large and dynamic team with a wide range of clients across different markets and sectors including residential, infrastructure, construction and healthcare You would provide support to our project managers and project directors based in the UK acoustics team. This may include for example: Managing projects or associated tasks and undertaking desk-based complex/challenging specialist project work for a wide range of schemes. Managing and inputting to project proposals. Line managing and mentoring staff to support the career development of more junior colleagues in the India team. Experience in reviewing deliverables, working to agreed timescales, within budget and to the expected quality. Enthusiasm, drive and ambition. Good organisation skills. title: Principal Engineer – Electrical
jobDescription: Senior Electrical Engineer will support the delivery of multidisciplinary consultancy services across thermal power, renewable energy, Data Centre and waste-to-energy (WTE) projects. The role encompasses a broad range of professional engineering services, including feasibility studies, due diligence and technical advisory, independent technical audits, reliability assessments, Owner’s Engineer (OE) and Lender’s Engineer (LE) assignments, vendor evaluations, and factory/site witnessing activities. The role is responsible for providing independent technical review, assurance, and engineering support on electrical systems across project lifecycle stages—ensuring compliance with international and Singapore standards, Transmission Codes, regulatory requirements, and client expectations, while maintaining focus on safety, reliability, operability, and commercial viability. Responsibilities • Support in all electrical engineering matters under the Power, Renewable Energy, Data Centre and WTE consultancy scope. • Provide independent technical review and assurance across consultancy assignments, including design, execution strategy, and operational considerations. • Interface effectively with Clients, Developers, EPC Contractors, OEMs, and stakeholders on electrical engineering matters. • Deliver and support a range of consultancy services, including feasibility studies and concept development, technical due diligence and lender’s advisory (Lender’s Engineer), Owner’s Engineer assignments, Independent technical audits and condition assessments, Single Point of Failure (SPOF) studies and system reliability assessments, Vendor evaluation and technical bid assessment, Site inspections and witnessing of factory/site acceptance tests. • Review electrical design deliverables, including electrical single line diagrams (SLDs), Power system studies, Protection and control philosophies, Control Architecture and SCADA system, Earthing and lightning protection systems, Cable sizing, routing, and segregation, Lighting system, layouts for plant and BESS facilities • Review electrical aspects of On & Off grid BESS integration, including PCS, battery containers, auxiliary power supplies, EMS interfaces and control philosophy, Protection coordination between BESS and CCGT systems, Grid code and frequency response compliance • Prepare technical specifications • Review and comment on technical specifications, data sheets, and vendor documents for all key electrical equipment i.e. GIS system, Generators, step-up and auxiliary transformers, HV/MV/LV switchgear, protection relays, HV/MV/LV Electrical cables, UPS, DC systems, BESS electrical equipment and interfaces etc. • Evaluate technical deviations, alternative proposals, and concession requests. • Grid & Regulatory Compliance. Ensure compliance with EMA Electrical & Generation License requirements, Singapore Transmission Code, SP Power Grid Standard Practices and connection requirements, Singapore Standards (SS), Fire codes and statutory approvals • Review grid connection studies and support electrical submissions to authorities. • Support grid synchronization, testing, and energization readiness. • Perform and review covering plant performance modelling and benchmarking, Availability, reliability, and maintainability (RAM) studies, Single Point of Failure (SPOF) assessments and risk evaluations. • Identify electrical design and interface risks across CCGT systems, WTE and Balance of Plant, Mechanical–Civil–Fire protection-control interfaces, Renewable integration (PV/Wind/BESS interfacing with grid-connected systems) • Prepare technical notes and design review comments, reports, calculations, and supporting documentation, meeting minutes and coordination records • Support coordination between electrical and other disciplines. • Any other duties deemed necessary to support the successful delivery of the Owner’s Engineer services. Key Competencies: • Good knowledge of power plant electrical systems and grid connections • Familiarity with WTE and/or renewable generation systems (advantageous) • Familiarity with renewable energy systems (Solar PV, Wind, BESS). • Familiarity with Cathodic Protection and Heat tracing system. • Ability to interpret engineering drawings, specifications, and study reports • Ability to perform structured, risk-based technical reviews of electrical designs. • Familiarity with IEC / IEEE standards, Singapore Standards and Transmission Codes and Grid connection requirements • Strong understanding of GIS/AIS, HV, MV and LV transformers, equipment design, operation, and maintenance. • Experience in performance analysis, reliability studies, and system optimization. • Effective stakeholder engagement, communication, and coordination skills. • Ability to balance technical, commercial, and schedule considerations. • Familiarity with ETAP, SKM, PSSE, MATLAB, PSCAD, PVSys, HOMER or equivalent electrical power system study tools is advantageous.. • Developing understanding of consultancy roles (OE/LE/audits). jobDescription: Quantity surveyor plays a key role in supporting the Head of Commercial for the Advisory Business Unit, assisting in the management of commercial risk, enhancing commercial performance, and maintaining strong contractual and client relationships across projects. The role contributes to effective commercial governance and sustainable project delivery through change management, commercial reporting, contract administration, and providing day‑to‑day commercial support to project and prospect leaders in alignment with business objectives. Commercial Risk Management Support the business unit in identifying, mitigating, and managing commercial risks across projects and business activities. Assist in preparing strategies to manage risks and opportunities, including notices, correspondence, record keeping, and follow-up actions from commercial meetings. Ensure commercial standards, procedures, and processes are consistently applied across all commercial activities. Project Commercial Oversight Participate in regular project reviews to identify commercial opportunities and risks and help drive actions that improve financial performance. Maintain current opportunity and risk registers, including accurate values, commentary, and status updates. Review project financial accounts and monthly reports to assess working capital exposure, profitability, and revenue recognition. Contractual Support & Change Management Provide support on contract negotiations, post-tender clarifications, and final settlements with clients and sub-consultants. Support project teams with preparation and agreement of variations, extensions of time, prolongation claims, and other change submissions. Prepare commercial and contractual correspondence to clients and provide practical advice to project leaders on commercial matters. Working Capital & Stakeholder Collaboration Work closely with finance, legal, and working capital teams to resolve disputed or delayed invoices and improve cash collection. Support business reporting by providing accurate commercial updates and status commentary for regular internal reporting. Build effective working relationships with project leaders, business unit leadership, clients, and sub-consultants to enable successful project outcomes. CORE COMPETENCIES Key Skills and Competencies • Strong understanding of commercial management, contract administration, risk management, and change control within consultancy or construction environments. • Sound knowledge of contracts, procurement processes, and financial controls relevant to project delivery. • Strong financial analysis and reporting capability, including working capital awareness, profitability monitoring, and revenue recognition support. • Excellent negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills with the ability to build relationships at all levels. • Ability to prepare clear contractual correspondence and support claims, variations, and commercial submissions. Behaviors & Attributes • Proactive, detail-oriented, and able to identify risks and opportunities early. • Commercially astute and capable of exercising sound judgement in complex situations. • Collaborative and dependable, with a strong commitment to supporting project and business unit success. • Resilient and professional when managing competing priorities and challenging stakeholder environments. • Committed to high standards of accuracy, accountability, and continuous improvement. • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Quantity Surveying, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline. • Professional membership or progress toward chartership with a recognised institution such as RICS, ICE, or equivalent is preferred. • Proven experience in a similar commercial or quantity surveying role within the construction, infrastructure, or design consultancy sector. • Practical experience in contract administration, commercial reporting, change management, and supporting claims or variations. • Strong understanding of financial management principles including working capital, invoicing, profitability, and revenue recognition. • Experience working with internal stakeholders such as finance, legal, and project teams to resolve commercial and contractual matters. • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to prepare clear commercial correspondence and reports. • Demonstrated professionalism, resilience, and a proactive approach to delivering high-quality commercial support. title: Principal Consultant - GIS
jobDescription:
WSP is seeking an experienced GIS Consultant to join our multidisciplinary team supporting the US Earth & Environment (E&E) Business Line. The GIS consultant will provide advanced expertise in power generation and distribution, geospatial analyses, environmental data management, and cartographic support for projects related to site investigation and remediation, environmental impact assessments, environmental planning and permitting, and other similar areas. The team you will join offers an exciting diversity of projects and clients. You will lead delivery, mentor junior staff, and ensure technical excellence across all phases of the project. The role will be based in either Bengaluru or Noida. Lead end‑to‑end GIS workflows for environmental projects, from data acquisition, digitizing, processing, analyses, QA/QC and final cartographic delivery, with minimal supervision Apply advanced expertise in Arc GIS Pro, including geoprocessing model design, spatial analysis, and production automation to improve efficiency, consistency, and repeatability. Design, manage, and maintain scalable project geodatabases, including schema development, metadata standards, and long-term data stewardship. Produce defensible GIS analyses and presentation-quality cartographic products (maps, drawings, figures, charts, posters, etc.) for diverse audience including clients, regulators, engineers, and non-technical stakeholders. Conduct constraint, sensitivity, and impact analyses for routing and siting studies, translating complex environmental data into decision ready outputs. Proactively advise project teams on map design, scale, symbology, and data limitations to prevent misinterpretation or misuse of GIS outputs. Implement and support mobile GIS and field data collection workflows, including data validation, post-processing, and enterprise integration. Configure and maintain ESRI web mapping environments (e.g., Arc GIS Online and/or enterprise portal) to support project teams, including publishing layers, organizing web maps, and controlling permissions/roles. Maintain high standards of data quality management, including QA/QC procedures, error detection, and documentation of assumptions and limitations. Manage multiple concurrent assignments while meeting consulting budgets, schedules, and quality expectations. Bachelor’s degree in Geography, GIS, Environmental Sciences, Geology, Environmental Engineering, or a related field. 15+ years of experience in delivering GIS products for environmental consulting projects. Demonstrated experience in Power & Energy sector with routing/siting and engineering support for electric transmission systems. Demonstrated proficiency with ESRI technologies, including Arc GIS Pro, Arc GIS Online, and Arc GIS Server. Proven experience designing and supporting mobile data collection solutions using Arc GIS Field Maps and Survey123, including supporting field tools, user access management and organizational GIS portals. Strong understanding of geodatabase design and management, including domains, subtypes, and feature class operations. Excellent oral and written communication skills and attention to detail, with an emphasis on professional map and visualization standards. Ability to independently scope GIS tasks, estimate effort, and communicate constraints and trade offs to project managers. Commitment to ethical data use, safety standards, and professional conduct, aligned with WSP policies.

title: Senior Engineer- Fire and Life Safety
jobDescription: The Senior Fire Engineer will be part of the Fire Protection Engineering Team to serve as an expert technical consultant on fire safety, fire prevention, fire protection and life safety engineering issues for internal and external clients. The Fire Engineer will provide expert advice and perform highly advanced complex reviews of plans and specifications for fire protection planning, fire suppression, automatic sprinkler systems, life safety analysis and hazard analysis. Mechanical / Civils Degree from an accredited university or Fire Technology Degree from an accredited university of technology in fire safety. 8-12 years' experience in Fire Engineering as well as Consulting Engineering experience would be advantageous. Working within the Nordic (Swedish) business, the role requires leading geometric design, roadway modelling, and preparation of design documentation while managing multiple projects simultaneously. The Senior Engineer collaborates closely with teams across India and Sweden, ensuring seamless coordination, adherence to lead country requirements, and successful delivery of all project outputs with full accountability having relevant design/ junior team supervision. Design Leadership & Delivery: Lead the design packages and delivery of highway design solutions, ensuring compliance with applicable standards, codes, and safety requirements while reporting to the Principal Engineer/Project Manager. Take ownership of preparing and reviewing highway designs and drawings using tools such as Civil 3D, Auto CAD, Novapoint, etc., ensuring technical accuracy and quality. Undertake detailed roadway design including alignments, junctions/intersections, carriageways, superelevation, and associated roadside features such as footways, cycleways, access points, and safety systems. Plan, manage, and track design deliverables to meet project timelines, quality benchmarks, and regulatory requirements. Project Management & Coordination: Support project planning by contributing to cost estimates, progress schedules, and resource allocation, considering project complexity and constraints. Monitor progress against milestones, proactively identifying and communicating risks, dependencies, and mitigation measures to the Principal Engineer/Project Manager/Lead PM. Lead coordination of RFIs and technical interfaces with other disciplines, lead region design leads, and other stakeholders to ensure timely inputs and approvals. Provide technical support during design development phases, resolving design queries and ensuring alignment with design intent. Stakeholder Engagement & Design Team Leadership: Collaborate effectively with multidisciplinary teams and other stakeholders to ensure seamless project delivery. Lead and actively contribute to design reviews and constructability assessments, ensuring practical, efficient, and safe design solutions. Provide technical direction during design development, identifying risks, driving solutions, and supporting decision-making for project advancement. Mentor and train junior team members (Assistant Engineers, Engineers), fostering technical capability and ensuring consistent delivery standards. Mentor and advise CAD Technicians on output workflows, standards and quality aspects. Quality, Compliance & Governance: Take accountability for implementing quality control procedures and best practices to ensure consistency and accuracy of deliverables. Conduct and oversee internal reviews, checks, and audits to ensure compliance with design standards, safety, and environmental requirements having followed the Nordics
- Project Delivery Process. Ensure adherence to Quality Assurance processes, maintaining proper documentation and ensuring all deliverables meet checking and approval protocols prior to submission. Ensure adherence to WSP HSEQ standards and Business Management System (BMS). Key Competencies & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering (Master’s preferred). with 6–10 years of relevant experience in highways design, including international project exposure. Strong knowledge of highway engineering and geometric design principles. Well versed with alignments, carriageways, superelevation and embankment esign. Proven experience across feasibility and detailed design stages. Familiarity with international standards such as AASHTO, DMRB, TSRGD, and preferably Swedish/Nordic guidelines (e.g., Trafikverket VGU, ATB VÄG).etc. Design Tools & Digital Skills: Advanced proficiency in Civil 3D (including Naviate/SAC) and Auto CAD. Proven experience in mentoring junior engineers and driving team capability development. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate across multidisciplinary and international level project teams. Capable in effectively presenting and resolve technical issues with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong analytical mindset with the ability to develop innovative, practical solutions under pressure; self-driven, accountable, and proactive in continuous learning and team development. Sound understanding of QA processes, HSEQ standards, and adherence to organizational systems/BMS, ensuring compliance across all deliverables. Other Skills Good interpersonal skills with colleagues and clients. Fluent spoken English with excellent verbal, written and graphic communication skills. Self-motivated and adaptable, maintaining a confident demeanour when change occurs. Ability to work under pressure and with minimum of supervision. Join us at WSP – India GCC and take on the exciting challenge of spearheading significant highway projects that contribute to the development and improvement of international infrastructure.
