title: Principal GIS Consultant - GeoAI & Spatial Intelligence
jobDescription:
As a Principal Geospatial Consultant with WSP, you'll support multi-disciplinary projects within the Geospatial team as part of the Transformation & Digital Insights service line, with a particular focus on supporting complex infrastructure and land projects. Reporting to an Associate / Associate Director and collaborating with GIS, Geospatial, Data Science Data Engineering, AI and Technical Specialist teams, you'll help the team grow both personally and technically to maintain top-tier client service. As a Principal Geospatial Consultant specialising in Geo AI and Spatial Intelligence, you will sit at the intersection of GIS engineering and applied artificial intelligence—designing, building, and deploying advanced geospatial solutions across infrastructure, utilities, land and property, water, and environmental sectors. This is a hands-on technical role. You will develop production-grade Python workflows, design and optimise spatial data pipelines, and integrate AI and machine learning frameworks into GIS environments to deliver scalable, data-driven insights. You will act as a subject matter expert for both internal teams and clients, translating emerging Geo AI capabilities into practical, real-world applications. You will play a key role in shaping our Geo AI approach within the practice—defining methodologies, driving innovation, and embedding automation and intelligence across project delivery. Alongside this, you will mentor and support junior colleagues, fostering technical excellence and helping to grow our geospatial capability in line with market demand. Join WSP at a time of growth and transformation, where you will play a key role in delivering geospatial solutions across major infrastructure schemes, supporting projects across sectors such as land management, property and planning, energy and transportation. What we will be looking for you to demonstrate… Strong technical skills in Esri platforms, scripting (preferably Python), FME, SQL, data management, and data science workflows along with a proactive, resilient mindset and exceptional problem-solving abilities are required. The ideal candidate will have a customer focused mindset to deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients. • Design and develop Geo AI solutions — including object detection, feature extraction, change detection, and predictive spatial modelling — using both Esri tools and open-source AI frameworks. • Write production-grade Python toolboxes, automation scripts, and spatial data pipelines for Arc GIS Pro, Arc GIS Enterprise, and SDE environments. • Integrate deep learning frameworks (e.g. Py Torch or Tensor Flow) and ML libraries (such as scikit-learn or Hugging Face) into geospatial workflows to solve clientspecific problems at scale. • Lead technical delivery on Geo AI project workstreams across utilities network analysis, land ownership and registry data, and water / environmental constraint modelling. • Collaborating with project managers and sector leads to scope, estimate, and quality-assure GIS and Geo AI deliverables. • Provide technical assurance and peer review of Geo AI and GIS outputs to ensure quality, robustness, and compliance with agreed standards. • Produce clear technical documentation and methodology reports, and present findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. • Mentor and support junior GIS analysts and developers, reviewing code and promoting best practices in spatial data science. • Stay current with Esri platform releases, emerging Geo AI tools, and relevant academic or industry research, contributing to internal capability development. Essentials
- you will need skills and experience in these areas to be successful in the

title: Associate - Geoenvironmental
jobDescription:
We are looking for an exceptional person to lead our Ground and Water (Contaminated Land) team in India. You will have at least 15 years’ post-graduate experience working in the Geo-environmental field. The successful candidate will play a key role in supporting and coaching team members in the GCC Ground & Water Team. This will include the day-to-day management of a team, delivery of projects working closely with and being supported by other team members, Project Managers and Directors within the UK team. The position would suit someone with extensive experience in the UK contaminated land sector who would like to further develop their leadership and technical consultancy skills and build a successful team. The role involves organizational and administrative responsibilities and requires skills, such as planning, analysis and judgement. The Team Leader will be responsible for both the technical and commercial delivery of projects, including effective delegation and checking of work, and will be responsible for the line management and mentoring of more junior staff ensuring their technical development and career progression. The Team Leader is also expected to ensure that their own professional skills and competencies are continually improved to meet the requirements of the team and any relevant professional bodies. RESPONSIBILITIES:
Leadership of projects and line management of staff including supporting career development (technical, professional and personal) goals of junior staff, to encourage training and learning. Be able to travel to support team members in other offices from time to time. Provision of reliable, effective and efficient delivery of environmental consultancy services and seeks regular feedback on performance. To work in an integrated manner with limited supervision where appropriate and to understand the task at hand; what is required, when it is required etc. and to deliver tasks in a cost effective and timely manner. Preparation and self-checking of interpretative (non-specialist) reports. title: Data Engineer
jobDescription:
WSP India is currently seeking Data Engineer for Australia Mining team. They shall be responsible for supporting our AU business through GCC. This role is responsible for designing, building, and maintaining the data engineering layer of our Microsoft Fabric platform. The Data Engineer will own the end-to-end data pipeline lifecycle — from ingesting raw data out of engineering and construction tools through to delivering clean, modelled, AI-ready datasets that power reporting, dashboards, and decision-making across the business. This is a greenfield opportunity — the successful candidate will be instrumental in shaping the platform from the ground up, making foundational decisions on standards, and patterns that will scale across the organisation. We are looking for someone who takes genuine ownership , thrives in ambiguity, and is energised by the challenge of building something from scratch rather than maintaining an existing setup. Build and maintain Data Factory pipelines for API-based data ingestion (REST, OData). Develop Python ETL scripts for custom extraction, API polling, and file ingestion. Develop and maintain Spark/Python notebooks (Python/Py Spark) and SQL-based transformation logic. Create Dataflows Gen2 (Power Query) for handling Excel/CSV-based messy data. Implement incremental loads, watermarking, and CDC patterns. Integrate data from Dataverse and other enterprise sources into Fabric. Own Bronze → Silver transformations (cleansing, deduplication, standardisation) Support Silver → Gold transformations (star schema, fact/dimension modelling) Prepare feature datasets for AI/ML workloads and support notebook-based model development Implement data quality frameworks (validation rules, anomaly detection) Build and optimise Power BI semantic models (Direct Lake) Prepare datasets for reporting and basic analytics use cases. Monitor pipeline performance, platform health, and Fabric capacity (F64+), including cost optimisation. Maintain documentation (data dictionaries, pipeline inventory, architecture decisions) Manage Fabric capacity — pause/resume scheduling, scaling, and cost optimisation Key Competencies / Skills: Microsoft Fabric
- Hands-on with Lakehouse, Warehouse, Data Factory, Dataflows Gen2, Notebooks, One Lake. Python/SQL
- Strong experience in ETL scripting, data engineering, transformation logic and notebook development. Working knowledge of file formats, partitioning strategies, ACID transactions, schema evolution Power BI
- Semantic Model Creation, DAX fundamentals, Direct Lake mode configuration. Star Schema Design – Fact/dimension modelling, slowly changing dimensions (SCD), aggregation patterns. Data Factory / ETL — Pipeline design, REST/OData connectors, incremental loads, error handling. Git / CI/CD — Version control practices, Fabric deployment pipelines, Azure Dev Ops integration. Must be able to prioritize, multitask as well as work independently. Must be able to maintain quality of work and at the same time meet multiple deadlines. Excellent interpersonal skills cum responsiveness to others Strong technical skills which demonstrate the ability to implement and maintain an enterprise level reporting solution. Desirable: Experience with Microsoft Dataverse and Power Apps integration Familiarity with Microsoft Purview for governance and cataloguing Understanding of the EPCM project lifecycle — feasibility through construction and commissioning Experience with Agile / iterative delivery in small, cross-functional teams Experience working in enterprise environments, particularly in the engineering and construction sector Exposure to project controls data — schedules (P6/MSP), cost systems, document management, EVM. Must have minimum 7-10 years of experience with Microsoft Fabric certification – DP 600, DP700s would be advantageous. jobDescription: As a Principal Engineer (Modelling) within our Water Team, you will provide leadership and technical support on waste water/urban drainage modelling projects to ensure accurate and efficient project delivery for internal and external clients. title: Tunnel Engineer – Underground Structures
jobDescription: We are seeking a Tunnel Engineer – Underground Structures (Mining & Civil) to join our Global Capability Centre (GCC) team , supporting the design and delivery of underground structures for mining and civil infrastructure projects. The successful candidate will have a strong structural engineering background and experience designing permanent underground works, including tunnel linings, shaft linings, underground chambers, portals, declines and associated infrastructure. They will work closely with geotechnical, mining and construction teams to deliver practical and robust underground solutions, who enjoys the challenges of underground engineering and understands how ground conditions influence structural design, without necessarily being a geotechnical specialist. Design and assess underground structures including: Shaft linings Tunnel and cavern linings Declines and access tunnels Underground chambers and excavations Portal structures Retaining and support structures associated with underground works Develop reinforced concrete, steel and composite structural solutions for underground infrastructure. Undertake structural analysis and design considering: Ground loading Hydrostatic pressures Construction loading Operational and long-term durability requirements Produce engineering calculations, technical reports, specifications and design drawings. Work collaboratively with geotechnical engineers to understand ground conditions and incorporate ground-structure interaction into designs. Interface with multidisciplinary teams including mining, geotechnical, civil, mechanical and construction specialists. Support site activities, design reviews and technical queries during construction. Degree in Civil or Structural Engineering. 5–8 years of experience in structural design for tunnels, shafts, underground structures or major civil infrastructure. Strong understanding of reinforced concrete and structural steel design. Experience of underground structures such as: Segmental tunnel linings Cast in-situ concrete linings Shaft linings Underground retaining structures Buried and below-ground structures Familiarity with Eurocodes and relevant international design standards. Experience using structural analysis software. Ability to communicate technical issues clearly and work effectively in multidisciplinary teams. Desirable Experience Mining infrastructure projects. Civil tunnelling projects. Underground construction methods including TBM, NATM/SCL, shaft sinking and mined excavations. Numerical modelling experience. Chartered Engineer status or working toward chartership. Site or construction experience relating to underground works. title: BIM Technician - Rail
jobDescription: We are seeking to recruit an ambitious and dynamic BIM Modeller to join the Integrated Complementary Resource Centre GCC AU India BIM team in Bengaluru to work alongside our AU Rail disciplines. The successful candidate will be working in a team environment to develop and deliver projects through various stages of design, from feasibility to planning/detailed design and construction. Working with the Civil & Structural Group Lead in AU to develop cost-effective, efficient and innovative Civil & Structural solutions to complex problems and then using engineering tools such as Open Building Designer(Aeosim), Tekla, Robot, Auto CAD and Civil 3D to create practical designs based on these solutions. Create and maintain detailed 3D structural models using BIM software (3D Micro Station, AECOsim / Open Building Designer, Project Wise, Auto CAD, i Twin) Interpret architectural and engineering plans to develop integrated structural models. Generate and extract 2D drawings, details, and schedules from 3D models for construction documentation. Perform clash detection and resolve spatial conflicts between structural, architectural, and MEP components. Coordinate with architects, engineers, and project managers to ensure model accuracy and compliance with project requirements. Update and modify models as per revised plans, specifications, or redline markups. Maintain project BIM libraries, templates, and families. You will be working and supporting a range of infrastructure schemes to independently develop engineering BIM models and drawings under the relevant standards. You will be expected to play a proactive part in the design process and be active on several projects at any given time. You will be contributing to all types of projects. You will read and adhere to all relevant policies and procedures for Health and Safety, including the H&S Policy, H&S Manual, and Local Procedures Manual You will take responsibility for your own personal development with the support of the line manager and follow an agreed development plan. You will assist in the development of others in the team. Key Competencies / Skills Ability to utilise 3D Micro Station, AECOsim / Open Building, Project Wise, Auto CAD in adherence to defined CAD & BIM standards to develop 3D modelling, layouts, labelling, dimensioning, sheet layout, design details and other appropriate design concepts. Ability to read and interpret 2D and 3D CAD drawings and models to assist with investigations of engineering problems. Proven ability to work up drawings (plans, sections & details) from Engineers basic sketches to full working drawings. Ability to liaise with the design teams as necessary to coordinate design and drawing production. Capable of multi-tasking and managing multiple projects with the ability to accurately predict the time required to fulfil the individual scopes of work required. Assists with establishing, maintaining and enforcing the use of proper CAD & BIM standards and procedures. Undertake reviews of work produced by others to ensure high quality of CAD output. AU / any International Rail project experience and working knowledge of International design standards. You should be able to demonstrate some experience and working knowledge of relevant technical design guidance and standards, such as ISO 19650, Uniclass 2015 etc., You should be able to understand and communicate BIM and CAD standards for use on Rail engineering projects and possess an appropriate overall level of knowledge of the AU/ International infrastructure design sector. Proficient in the use of standard office software. Experience in supervising and coordinating the CAD output of others within a multidisciplinary project environment. Commitment to work as part of a design team focused on project delivery. Good understanding and knowledge of Multi-Discipline Rail Projects Good written and verbal communication skills. At least one key area such as a Diploma/Engineering in Mechanical / Electrical / Civil Engineering, with 5-10 years relevant work experience in Bentley/Autodesk BIM Software. Excellent working knowledge of Civil Core knowledge of Micro Station/AECOsim / Open Building Designer. Good working knowledge of the relevant Metro Rail discipline. title: Coastal Engineer
jobDescription: We are seeking a motivated and technically sound Coastal Engineer to support the design and delivery of coastal and marine infrastructure projects. The role involves contributing to the design of coastal protection works, beach design, marina developments, intake and outfall design, dredging works, and navigation works. Design and engineering of coastal protection structures, including breakwaters, revetments, seawalls, groynes, and shoreline protection systems. Design of intake and outfall systems, including the design of intake towers, anchor blocks, pipeline profiling, and determination of elevations for intake and outfall chambers (onshore and offshore) Assist in beach design and nourishment studies, including development of beach profiles, understanding sediment characteristics, evaluating shoreline response, and supporting preliminary erosion/accretion assessments. Support the preparation of dredging design and marine earthworks, including determination of dredge levels (based on navigation and hydraulic requirements), basin and channel geometry development, estimation of dredging quantities and material characteristics Support scour assessment and sediment-related evaluations, including estimation of local scour, understanding sediment movement, and contributing to protective design measures. Prepare and check engineering calculations, technical reports, and design documentation, ensuring clarity, consistency, and compliance with project specifications and applicable standards. Coordinate with CAD/BIM teams for preparation of drawings, including cross-sections, layout plans, and details, and review drawings to ensure alignment with engineering design intent. Work closely with multidisciplinary teams to integrate inputs into marine design and ensure coordinated delivery. Support project execution by adhering to project timelines, quality standards, and internal review processes, while progressively taking ownership of assigned design tasks. title: Senior Energy Researcher and Policy Consultant
jobDescription: Senior Energy Researcher and Policy Consultant The Global Integrated Assessment Modelling team is developing and applying the models Prometheus and OPEN-PROM. Our focus is the energy transition towards decarbonization, and we apply data science, energy-economy models, and other relevant tools to analyze in detail the shift to a greener energy and economic system. We are looking for a Senior Energy Researcher and Policy Consultant to join our team of experienced researchers and engage with us in further developing and applying our national and global Models for energy and climate policy scenario analysis. Key Responsibilities Review and synthesise scientific, technical, and market reports into structured inputs for quantitative modelling and assessment. Develop policy-relevant insights, including policy recommendations and policy briefs, based on modelling results. Apply global and national energy system and integrated assessment models within EU-funded research projects, providing analytical support to national and international climate policy processes, including contributions to IPCC process Draft reports and/or presentations on the energy sector based on model results. Take end-to-end responsibility for research and consultancy projects, acting autonomously or in close coordination with senior colleagues as required. Contribute to proposal preparation in collaboration and alignment with the unit director and the serior staff. Monitor EU and global climate and energy policy developments and assess their implications for ongoing modelling analyses. Liaise between modelling teams and policy-oriented work to ensure consistency between quantitative results and narrative outputs Support the interpretation, validation, and contextualisation of modelling results for different policy and stakeholder audiences. Assist in ensuring quality control and coherence of modelling-related content across project deliverables and reports. Key Competencies and Experience Hold an MSc and/or Ph D in engineering, applied mathematics, computational modelling, operations research, mathematical economics, energy/climate policy, or physics. Professional experience in energy systems analysis, climate policy and/or integrated assessment modelling, including the development and interpretation of scenarios for policy analysis. Preference for applied experience in using analytical and/or modelling tools, with programming knowledge in R, Matlab, Python, or preferably GAMS. Large experience in using the Microsoft Suite, especially excel for data analysis Experience translating quantitative modelling results into policy-relevant insights for non-technical audiences (e.g. policymakers, stakeholders, project partners). Demonstrated ability to delivering high-quality results. Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset, with a collaborative attitude and eagerness to learn. Strong writing skills, with experience in academic articles, technical reports, or policy reports in English (desirable). Fluent in verbal and written communication in English. Manage and coordinate research and consultancy projects, either independently or jointly with senior colleagues, ensuring timely and high-quality delivery. Demonstrated capability to work autonomously on complex analytical tasks, while contributing effectively within multidisciplinary project teams. BGV: Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification (“BGV”) check conducted by a third-party agency appointed by WSP India. Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner”.

title: Consultant - Environmental Acoustics
jobDescription:
WSP India is seeking a highly accomplished and motivated Environmental Acoustics Consultant to join our Earth & Environment (E&E) business, based in Bengaluru/Noida, India. The successful candidate will play a pivotal role in supporting our South Africa-based Environment team, contributing to prestigious, high-profile projects across the E&E sector. This opportunity offers the rare advantage of working within a truly global environment, collaborating with a multi-disciplinary team of around 200 talented professionals in South Africa, spanning Environmental Planning & Advisory, Technical Services, Mine Water, and Mine Waste. The role offers a unique platform to expand your professional expertise, influence international projects, and contribute to advancing WSP’s reputation as a leader in innovative infrastructure solutions. What We Do The role will be an Environmental Acoustics Consultant working on projects within South Africa and internationally, with a focus on baseline data analysis, acoustic inventory compilations and acoustic modelling. The role will also require good reporting skills for the compilation of monitoring reports and Environmental Acoustic Impact Assessments. It is noted that the role is primarily for environmental acoustics for basic impact assessments and not for detailed building acoustics type of work. WSP Africa also runs projects outside of South Africa, presenting access to a diverse range of projects. As a Consultant
- Environmental Acoustics, you will: Serve as a core member of the ZA GCC India E&E team, delivering strategic support from India to develop and deliver projects through various stages. Conduct data analysis of baseline acoustic monitoring data. Compile acoustic inventories. Conduct environmental acoustic modelling (Cadna A and attenuation-over-distance acoustic calcs). Compile Environmental Acoustic Impact Assessments. Process and format ambient monitoring data and compilation of ad hoc monitoring reports. Assist with compilation of environmental acoustic proposals as and when needed. Act as a SHEQ role model, behaving consistently within the company’s health, safety, environmental and quality vision and policies. Contribute to the identification of SHEQ risks and drive processes to achieve Zero Harm. Embrace, display and promote company values, ensuring a safe working environment is maintained at all times. MANDATORY SKILLS Knowledge of the fundamentals of environmental acoustics and international legislation (e.g., WHO or IFC). Technical report writing skills to produce professional reports in fluent English. Technical skills to manage, verify and analyze data. Minimum 4 years’ experience in acoustic modelling. A relevant degree (ideally at Master’s level), equivalent qualification in Acoustics. Acoustic inventory compilation, basic attenuation-over-distance calculations and acoustic modelling in Cadna A. Demonstrable project management experience at an introductory level. title: Associate Technical Director- Structures
jobDescription:
The Associate Technical Director – Building Structures will lead and manage the delivery of building structural engineering projects across a range of sectors in the UK. The role involves technical leadership, project management, client engagement, team development, and ensuring high-quality design outputs in line with UK standards (Eurocode standards). The Associate will act as a key link between clients, project teams, and senior leadership, driving technical excellence and commercial success. Technical Leadership & Delivery  Lead structural design for medium to large building projects using Eurocodes and UK best practices.  Provide high-level technical review and approval of calculations, drawings, and reports.  Drive innovative, safe, and sustainable design solutions.  Ensure compliance with QA/QC procedures and project standards.  Oversee digital engineering tools (Revit, Tekla/structural BIM workflows).
2. Project Management  Manage full project lifecycle from concept to construction.  Develop scopes, deliverables, programmes, and fee proposals.  Monitor project progress, budgets, risks, and change control.  Coordinate with multidisciplinary design teams (architecture, MEP, civils).  Ensure timely delivery of design information to clients and contractors
3. Client Management & Business Development  Build strong client relationships through consistent delivery and technical excellence.  Represent the business in client meetings, presentations, design reviews, and coordinationwo rkshops.  Identify new opportunities and support bid development and proposal writing.  Contribute to growth of the structures team through networking and thought leadership.
4. Team Leadership & Development  Mentor, coach, and develop engineers and graduates within the structures team.  Lead resource planning, workload distribution, and team coordination.  Promote technical knowledge sharing, CPD, and internal training.  Support talent acquisition by participating in recruitment and interviews
5. Construction Support  Provide timely technical responses to RFIs and contractor queries  Attend site inspections, technical audits, and design compliance checks.  Support resolution of construction-stage challenges and value engineering options.
6. Required Skills & Experience Technical Skills  Strong understanding of structural behaviour in steel, RC, masonry, and timber.  Proficiency in design software (ETABS, STAAD, Robot, Tekla Structural Designer, SAFE, RAM).  Experience working in BIM-enabled environments (Revit).  Ability to lead technically complex projects independently. Professional Qualifications  Chartered Engineer IStruct E (highly desirable) or with ICE.  BEng/MEng/MSc in Civil or Structural Engineering. Experience  Typically, 15+ years of experience in building structure design and delivery.  Proven track record of leading UK-based multidisciplinary building projects  Experience with client-facing roles and team leadership Soft Skills  Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.  Strong problem-solving and decision-making capability  Commercial awareness and understanding of project financials.  Ability to manage multiple priorities under pressure. title: Intern, Architect
jobDescription: We are seeking a motivated Urban Planning Intern to support our team- Development, Planning and Urban Design on a range of projects across the Middle East and globally.
